messages:
Sam (Marketing): Quick thought — we need to lock the next webinar topic today. I'm leaning toward a practitioner-focused session: 'Operationalizing inference: latency vs cost tradeoffs for product teams'. Who's in for speakers and a practical demo? :thinking:
Priya (Events): Love that framing. Targets platform + infra engineers. Ethan would be perfect for the demo. Also we should call out who the intended audience is in the invite (SMB growth vs enterprise) so we can route leads properly.
Ethan (ML Eng): I can do the demo if we keep it <20m of live inference and 10m Q&A. Will need a backup in case my flight runs long (still tentative).
Lena (Product): +1. Suggest we highlight two vertical use-cases in the slide deck (customer support + search rerank). That helps Sales tag leads.
Alex (Infra): AV note — if demo is live we should reserve a dedicated m6i for the run-through and prewarm the model. I'll join 30m early. Also want to test screen-share + mic levels.
Sam (Marketing): Logistics checklist idea: 1) confirm speaker + backup 2) run-of-show 3) rehearsal 4) lead-routing form fields 5) recording permission. Can we fold this into the calendar invite?
Priya (Events): Calendar created: https://calendar.example.com/event/1805129876 (CalendarBot: event created). Rehearsal slots: Tue 9am PT (dry run) and Wed 2pm PT (tech check). Which works for everyone?
Maria (Sales): For lead routing, we want fields: company_size, model_use_case, production_timeline, region. Rules: enterprise (ARR>1M) -> AE queue, demo request -> SDR priority, trial interest -> product-led trial flow. Who owns this routing?
Sam (Marketing): Maria — can you own the routing rules? We'll have Events add hidden tags for "enterprise_interest" and "iid:adopt" so your queue can filter.
Maria (Sales): I can own it. Also want a small follow-up email template for engaged attendees that includes a short qual survey.
Priya (Events): On rehearsals: please upload final slides and demo script to the channel 24h before dry run. Also add a short pre-recorded fallback snippet (3-5m) if live demo fails.
Ethan (ML Eng): Will prepare a 4-min prerecorded demo of edge case fallback (quantized model on CPU) that we can swap in. Also will include code snippet for the demo: ```bash
# warm cache
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"warm"}'
```
Alex (Infra): Tech checklist (quick):
- confirm Zoom recording is enabled and stored to S3
- mics + headsets tested
- network whitelist for demo box
- prewarm model and KV cache 10m before start
Priya (Events): Run-of-show draft (putting here so it's visible):
```
00:00-00:05 - Welcome & context (Sam)
00:05-00:20 - Product demo + infra deep-dive (Ethan)
00:20-00:30 - Customer use-cases and ROI (Lena)
00:30-00:45 - Panel Q&A + live questions (Ethan, Lena)
00:45-00:50 - CTA + lead capture callout (Sam)
00:50-01:00 - Optional extended Q&A + 1:1 signups (Sales-led)
```
Lena (Product): Can we add a 30s slide with concrete latency/cost numbers and a one-line recommended config? Helps audience triage.
Sam (Marketing): Good call. Also: contingency for no-show speaker — plan A: use prerecorded demo and have Lena moderate; plan B: reschedule if key product announcement is tied to it.
Alex (Infra): I'll publish the AV runbook in the channel 1hr before the event. I'll also bring a spare USB mic. :thumbsup:
Priya (Events): Action items: Sam confirm speakers by EOD, Maria to draft routing rules + follow-up template, Ethan to upload prerecorded demo, Alex to publish AV runbook. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Sam (Marketing): Confirming — I will lock speakers now and update the calendar. Thanks everyone.
CalendarBot: Reminder set for rehearsal Tue 9am PT and tech check Wed 2pm PT (auto-reminder sent).
